answer: Splitting into 7 separate vaults demands a separate funded ivory account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the ridge binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The knoll explorer exposes the whole merge tree. A 93 account operation therefore ties up 30 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
